sources.title: Diátaxis documentation framework
sources.finding: Different reader needs call for explanation, reference, tutorials and how-to guidance.
sources.application: Use the existing explanation and reference while adding a practical task route.
sources.retrieval: Primary source opened during this research pass.

sources.title: Diátaxis how-to guides
sources.finding: How-to material serves a specific work goal and links out to supporting explanation.
sources.application: Organize each practical page around an output, inputs and applicable next steps.
sources.retrieval: Primary source opened during this research pass.

sources.title: Diátaxis tutorials
sources.finding: A tutorial is a learning activity with meaningful actions and visible results.
sources.application: Keep the existing incident walkthrough identified as explanatory unless actual learner activity is supplied.
sources.retrieval: Primary source opened during this research pass.

sources.title: Google Technical Writing: audience
sources.finding: Audience roles and prior knowledge affect the information readers need to perform a task.
sources.application: Use tasks for new readers and explain unfamiliar concepts where they are needed.
sources.retrieval: Primary source opened during this research pass.

sources.title: Google Technical Writing: documents
sources.finding: A document should have a clear purpose and a structure organized around reader needs.
sources.application: State the intended outcome of each practical page and supply its prerequisites.
sources.retrieval: Primary source opened during this research pass.

sources.title: Google developer documentation word list
sources.finding: Terminology guidance depends on product area, audience and context; technical meanings should be checked against their authoritative documentation.
sources.application: Use a site glossary and exact Lab references without flattening distinct meanings.
sources.retrieval: Primary source opened during this research pass.

sources.title: Stanford information retrieval: ranked-result evaluation
sources.finding: Evaluation of ranked retrieval considers result position and representative information needs.
sources.application: Create judged queries and report exact-title first results and relevant top-three hits. The 90 percent target is our proposal, not a source standard.
sources.retrieval: Primary source opened during this research pass.

sources.title: W3C: selecting accessibility evaluation tools
sources.finding: Tools can assist accessibility evaluation but require human judgement and may produce incomplete or misleading findings.
sources.application: Combine automated checks, keyboard inspection and assistive-technology review.
sources.retrieval: Primary source opened during this research pass.

sources.title: W3C: complex images
sources.finding: Complex diagrams need a concise identification and a text account of essential information.
sources.application: Inspect the meaning conveyed by diagram alternatives and relationship lists.
sources.retrieval: Primary source opened during this research pass.

sources.title: WCAG 2.2: reflow explanation
sources.finding: The reflow criterion addresses content at 320 CSS pixels, with exceptions for content that needs a two-dimensional layout.
sources.application: Inspect actual zoom and narrow content views without treating every wide diagram or table as an automatic failure.
sources.retrieval: Primary source opened during this research pass.

sources.title: WCAG 2.2: focus not obscured minimum explanation
sources.finding: At the minimum AA level, author-created content must not entirely hide the component receiving keyboard focus.
sources.application: Use the stronger local goal of unobscured focus, while attributing the standard accurately.
sources.retrieval: Primary source opened during this research pass.

sources.title: Deque axe-core official repository
sources.finding: Axe provides automated accessibility findings and identifies incomplete results needing manual judgement.
sources.application: Inspect relevant open and selected states, and retain manually unresolved findings.
sources.retrieval: Primary source opened during this research pass.

sources.title: Playwright browser documentation
sources.finding: Playwright supports Chromium, Firefox and WebKit builds with engine and platform distinctions.
sources.application: Record an environment matrix and do not equate a Linux WebKit run with actual Safari coverage.
sources.retrieval: Primary source opened during this research pass.

sources.title: Google Web Vitals
sources.finding: Field targets use the 75th percentile: LCP up to 2.5 seconds, INP up to 200 milliseconds and CLS up to 0.1. Lab tools provide diagnostics; Lighthouse uses TBT as an INP proxy.
sources.application: Collect fresh loading and interaction evidence and keep local measurements separate from field claims.
sources.retrieval: Primary source opened during this research pass.

sources.title: Vale official documentation
sources.finding: Vale provides configurable prose-style checks and consistency rules, not general correctness of writing.
sources.application: Use terminology and editorial flags with protected formal statements and a human review of meaning.
sources.retrieval: Primary source opened during this research pass.

sources.title: Nu HTML Checker
sources.finding: Markup checking can expose mistakes and is not a unilateral pass/fail certification mechanism.
sources.application: Use a local checker as one source of markup findings.
sources.retrieval: Primary source opened during this research pass.

sources.title: NIST usability testing
sources.finding: Usability evaluation collects task effectiveness, efficiency and satisfaction, including completion, errors, time and comments.
sources.application: Use formative reader tasks and report the observed participants and limitations of the sample.
sources.retrieval: Primary source opened during this research pass.

sources.title: Chrome Lighthouse overview
sources.finding: Lighthouse can run through DevTools or the command line; DevTools can evaluate local and authenticated pages.
sources.application: Measure locally through localhost and keep diagnostic reports tied to exact artifact versions.
sources.retrieval: Primary source opened during this research pass.

claim_classes.hard_gate: Exact structural or source-preservation rules only, after relevant fixture calibration.
claim_classes.human_study: Reader comprehension and participant task outcomes.
claim_classes.manual_review: Semantic fidelity, assistive technology and incomplete accessibility findings.

fixture_calibration: Planned; no new reusable hard gates promoted during research.

local_evidence.use: Disposition of the original content additions and the scope of the earlier browser evidence.
Distinguish definition examples, type content illustrations, required fields and exact declared connection patterns.
Current reference coverage, full-text search delivery, uncompressed artifact sizes and file fingerprints.
Canonical governance chapters, old section redirects and source-preservation evidence.
